question: Can a newcomer apply for CRA benefit and credit payments before filing a first Canadian tax return?
generated_answer: Yes. You can apply for the Canada child benefit (CCB) and the goods and services tax/harmonized sales tax (GST/HST) credit payments before you file your first Canadian tax return. You can also apply for the Canada workers benefit (CWB) if you are eligible. To apply for these benefits, you will need to provide your social insurance number (SIN) and other required information. You can apply online or by mail. Once you have applied, you will receive a notice of assessment (NOA) that will show the amount of benefit and credit payments you are entitled to receive. You can then use this information to file your first Canadian tax return.
